item.title: Ada Lovelace
item.description: Augusta Ada King, Countess of Lovelace was known for her work on the Analytical Engine. The general-purpose computer proposed by Charles Babbage. She was an English mathematician and writer. Born as the sole legitimate daughter of Lord Byron, the union of her parents was broken a month after her birth.
